finding.message: Dynamic SQL query formed via unescaped string interpolation or concatenation. Vulnerable to SQL Injection (CWE-89).
finding.code_snippet: var unsafeCommandText = $"SELECT Id, DirectDepositReference, NetPay FROM PayrollRecords WHERE PaymentStatus = '{rawPeriodFilter}'";

explanation: Replaced dynamic SQL string interpolation in `src/EmployeePortal.Integrations/Payroll/XmlPayrollExportBridge.cs` with constant parameterized query and bound parameters safely via SqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue (CWE-89).
remediation_summary: Replaced dynamic SQL string interpolation with parameterized SqlCommand query.
